# Diagram

Contents: [Use cases](#use-cases), [Chart IDs](#chart-ids), [Minimal spec](#minimal-spec), [Data](#data), [Options](#options), [Annotations](#annotations), [Sizing](#sizing), [Fixtures](#fixtures), [Not for](#not-for).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.mjs from the boardplot describe, list and fixtures payloads. -->

Deterministic node-edge diagrams with eight consulting presets, obstacle-aware routing, and structural descriptions. Type `diagram`.

## Use cases

- Process or organisation flow
- Driver tree or value chain
- Organisation chart

## Chart IDs

- `diagram.hierarchy`: fixture `org-structure`
- `diagram.issue-tree`: fixture `profit-issue-tree`
- `diagram.linear-process`: fixture `transformation-process`
- `diagram.customer-journey`: fixture `onboarding-journey`
- `diagram.circular-process`: fixture `operating-cycle`
- `diagram.strategy-house`: fixture `strategy-house`
- `diagram.roadmap`: fixture `growth-roadmap`
- `diagram.architecture`: fixture `protected-request`

## Minimal spec

```json
{
  "type": "diagram",
  "data": {
    "nodes": [
      { "id": "draft", "kind": "step", "shape": { "kind": "rectangle" }, "label": "Draft" },
      { "id": "review", "kind": "step", "shape": { "kind": "rectangle" }, "label": "Review" }
    ],
    "edges": [
      {
        "id": "next",
        "source": { "nodeId": "draft" },
        "target": { "nodeId": "review" },
        "arrowEnd": true
      }
    ]
  },
  "options": { "variant": "linear-process", "title": "Review follows drafting", "source": "Illustrative data" }
}
```

## Data

| Path | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| nodes | array | yes | One to 80 uniquely identified diagram nodes. |
| nodes[].id | string | yes | Trimmed identifier of at most 80 Unicode code points; control characters and the auto: prefix are reserved. |
| nodes[].kind | string | yes | Semantic node kind. Each variant reads: hierarchy 'entity'; issue-tree 'issue' or 'driver'; linear-process and circular-process 'step'; customer-journey 'painPoint'; roadmap 'milestone'. Another kind is refused with invalid-diagram-kind. strategy-house and architecture do not check the kind. One of `'entity'`, `'issue'`, `'driver'`, `'step'`, `'painPoint'`, `'vision'`, `'objective'`, `'initiative'`, `'enabler'`, `'foundation'`, `'milestone'`, `'callout'`. |
| nodes[].shape | object | yes | Node outline or icon-only shape. |
| nodes[].shape.kind (nodes[].shape branch 1) | string | yes | Select the rectangle node shape. One of `'rectangle'`. |
| nodes[].shape.kind (nodes[].shape branch 2) | string | yes | Select the roundedRect node shape. One of `'roundedRect'`. |
| nodes[].shape.radius (nodes[].shape branch 2) | number |  | Corner radius in layout pixels; omission uses the theme-scaled radius. |
| nodes[].shape.kind (nodes[].shape branch 3) | string | yes | Select the circle node shape. One of `'circle'`. |
| nodes[].shape.kind (nodes[].shape branch 4) | string | yes | Select the pill node shape. One of `'pill'`. |
| nodes[].shape.kind (nodes[].shape branch 5) | string | yes | Select the chevron node shape. One of `'chevron'`. |
| nodes[].shape.tip (nodes[].shape branch 5) | number |  | Chevron tip depth as a fraction of width; defaults to 0.16 and is capped by shape height. |
| nodes[].shape.kind (nodes[].shape branch 6) | string | yes | Select the text node shape. One of `'text'`. |
| nodes[].shape.kind (nodes[].shape branch 7) | string | yes | Select the icon node shape. One of `'icon'`. |
| nodes[].shape.name (nodes[].shape branch 7) | string | yes | Name from the built-in icon catalogue. |
| nodes[].shape.kind (nodes[].shape branch 8) | string | yes | Select the roof node shape. One of `'roof'`. |
| nodes[].shape.apex (nodes[].shape branch 8) | number |  | Horizontal roof apex as a fraction of width; defaults to 0.5. |
| nodes[].shape.eaveInset (nodes[].shape branch 8) | number |  | Inset of each roof eave as a fraction of width; defaults to 0. |
| nodes[].label | string | yes | Primary visible node label, at most 200 Unicode code points. |
| nodes[].secondaryLabel | string |  | Secondary line inside the node, at most 400 Unicode code points. |
| nodes[].caption | string |  | Supporting caption placed near the node, at most 400 Unicode code points. |
| nodes[].icon | string |  | Optional built-in icon displayed with the node label. |
| nodes[].badge | object |  | Border badge; long text uses a pill clear of the node label. |
| nodes[].badge.text | string | yes | Badge text, at most 200 Unicode code points. |
| nodes[].badge.role | string |  | Visual emphasis or semantic tone for this element. One of `'primary'`, `'accent'`, `'secondary'`, `'muted'`, `'good'`, `'bad'`, `'warn'`, `'category'`. |
| nodes[].badge.paletteKey | string |  | Stable categorical color key; required only when role is category. |
| nodes[].role | string |  | Visual emphasis or semantic tone for this element. One of `'primary'`, `'accent'`, `'secondary'`, `'muted'`, `'good'`, `'bad'`, `'warn'`, `'category'`. |
| nodes[].paletteKey | string |  | Stable categorical color key; required only when role is category. |
| nodes[].minSize | object |  | Minimum node dimensions, also bounded below by measured content. |
| nodes[].minSize.width | number | yes | Node width in layout pixels. |
| nodes[].minSize.height | number | yes | Node height in layout pixels. |
| nodes[].size | object |  | Requested node dimensions; measured content and minSize remain lower bounds. |
| nodes[].size.width | number | yes | Node width in layout pixels. |
| nodes[].size.height | number | yes | Node height in layout pixels. |
| nodes[].position | object |  | Authored node position in normalized plot coordinates. |
| nodes[].position.x | number | yes | Horizontal position as a fraction of the diagram plot width. |
| nodes[].position.y | number | yes | Vertical position as a fraction of the diagram plot height. |
| nodes[].ports | array |  | Up to 16 named connection ports, unique within this node. |
| nodes[].ports[].id | string | yes | Trimmed identifier of at most 80 Unicode code points; control characters and the auto: prefix are reserved. |
| nodes[].ports[].at | object | yes | Authored connection location on the node boundary. |
| nodes[].ports[].at.side (nodes[].ports[].at branch 1) | string | yes | Side of the node bounding rectangle used by this port. One of `'top'`, `'right'`, `'bottom'`, `'left'`. |
| nodes[].ports[].at.offset (nodes[].ports[].at branch 1) | number |  | Fraction along the side from left to right or top to bottom; defaults to 0.5. |
| nodes[].ports[].at.perimeter (nodes[].ports[].at branch 2) | number | yes | Fraction along the node bounding perimeter; 1 wraps to 0. |
| nodes[].ports[].intent | string |  | Allowed edge direction: incoming, outgoing or both. One of `'in'`, `'out'`, `'bidi'`. |
| nodes[].ports[].capacity | integer |  | Maximum number of edge endpoints assigned to this port. |
| nodes[].groupId | string |  | Id of an existing group containing this node. |
| nodes[].laneId | string |  | Id of an existing lane containing this node. |
| nodes[].order | integer |  | Ordering key: nodes sort by order, a node without one by its 0-based position in nodes, ties by id. Automatic step numbers follow this order. |
| nodes[].track | string |  | Architecture only: named cross-axis track. Nodes in one track line up across zones or lanes. |
| nodes[].span | string |  | Architecture only: a wide band across its lane, or a full-height rail in its zone. One of `'full'`. |
| edges | array |  | Up to 160 uniquely identified links between distinct existing nodes. |
| edges[].id | string | yes | Trimmed identifier of at most 80 Unicode code points; control characters and the auto: prefix are reserved. |
| edges[].source | object | yes | Edge origin, with an optional named output port. |
| edges[].source.nodeId | string | yes | Id of the existing node at this edge endpoint. |
| edges[].source.portId | string |  | Named port on the endpoint node; omission allows automatic port selection. |
| edges[].target | object | yes | Edge destination, with an optional named input port. |
| edges[].target.nodeId | string | yes | Id of the existing node at this edge endpoint. |
| edges[].target.portId | string |  | Named port on the endpoint node; omission allows automatic port selection. |
| edges[].routing | string |  | Requested edge path style. curved draws only in circular-process; other variants draw it orthogonal with diagram-route-degraded. One of `'straight'`, `'elbow'`, `'orthogonal'`, `'curved'`. |
| edges[].arrowStart | boolean |  | Whether to draw an arrowhead at the source endpoint. |
| edges[].arrowEnd | boolean |  | Whether to draw an arrowhead at the target endpoint. |
| edges[].dash | string |  | Edge stroke pattern. One of `'solid'`, `'dashed'`, `'dotted'`. |
| edges[].weight | string |  | Theme-scaled edge stroke weight. One of `'hairline'`, `'normal'`, `'strong'`. |
| edges[].role | string |  | Visual emphasis or semantic tone for this element. One of `'primary'`, `'accent'`, `'secondary'`, `'muted'`, `'good'`, `'bad'`, `'warn'`, `'category'`. |
| edges[].paletteKey | string |  | Stable categorical color key; required only when role is category. |
| edges[].label | string |  | Optional visible label, at most 200 Unicode code points. |
| edges[].waypoints | array |  | Up to 12 authored route waypoints in normalized plot coordinates. |
| edges[].waypoints[].x | number | yes | Horizontal position as a fraction of the diagram plot width. |
| edges[].waypoints[].y | number | yes | Vertical position as a fraction of the diagram plot height. |
| edges[].flow | string |  | Architecture only: a return edge does not set the node order and may close a loop. Default forward. One of `'forward'`, `'return'`. |
| groups | array |  | Up to 32 named visual groups referenced by node.groupId. |
| groups[].id | string | yes | Trimmed identifier of at most 80 Unicode code points; control characters and the auto: prefix are reserved. |
| groups[].title | string | yes | Visible group title, at most 200 Unicode code points. |
| groups[].padding | number |  | Space in layout pixels around the group members. |
| groups[].order | integer |  | Authored ordering key used by the selected diagram variant. |
| groups[].role | string |  | Visual emphasis or semantic tone for this element. One of `'primary'`, `'accent'`, `'secondary'`, `'muted'`, `'good'`, `'bad'`, `'warn'`, `'category'`. |
| groups[].paletteKey | string |  | Stable categorical color key; required only when role is category. |
| lanes | array |  | Up to 32 named partitions referenced by node.laneId. |
| lanes[].id | string | yes | Trimmed identifier of at most 80 Unicode code points; control characters and the auto: prefix are reserved. |
| lanes[].label | string |  | Optional visible label, at most 200 Unicode code points. |
| lanes[].orientation | string | yes | Lane direction in the diagram. customer-journey and roadmap, the variants that read lanes, refuse horizontal. One of `'horizontal'`, `'vertical'`. |
| lanes[].order | integer |  | Authored ordering key used by the selected diagram variant. |
| lanes[].role | string |  | Visual emphasis or semantic tone for this element. One of `'primary'`, `'accent'`, `'secondary'`, `'muted'`, `'good'`, `'bad'`, `'warn'`, `'category'`. |
| lanes[].paletteKey | string |  | Stable categorical color key; required only when role is category. |
| key | array |  | Up to 8 entries naming what a node fill or an edge line style means, drawn as the diagram key above the plot; a good, bad or warn node fill needs one, and so does a dashed or dotted edge. |
| key[].role (key[] branch 1) | string | yes | The node role whose fill this entry names. One of `'primary'`, `'accent'`, `'secondary'`, `'muted'`, `'good'`, `'bad'`, `'warn'`, `'category'`. |
| key[].paletteKey (key[] branch 1) | string |  | Stable categorical color key; required only when role is category. |
| key[].label (key[] branch 1) | string | yes | What the fill means, at most 80 Unicode code points. |
| key[].line (key[] branch 2) | string | yes | The edge style this entry names, drawn as the edges draw it. One of `'solid'`, `'dashed'`, `'dotted'`. |
| key[].label (key[] branch 2) | string | yes | What the line style means, at most 80 Unicode code points. |
| channels | array |  | Architecture only: up to 16 shared labels, each for edges that cross one gutter. |
| channels[].id | string | yes | Trimmed identifier of at most 80 Unicode code points; control characters and the auto: prefix are reserved. |
| channels[].edgeIds | array | yes | Ids of the edges this label names; they must cross one common gutter. |
| channels[].label | string | yes | The shared label, at most 80 Unicode code points. |

## Options

| Path | Type | Values | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| variant | string | `'hierarchy'`, `'issue-tree'`, `'linear-process'`, `'customer-journey'`, `'circular-process'`, `'strategy-house'`, `'roadmap'`, `'architecture'` |  | Required structural layout variant for the diagram. |
| flow | string | `'columns'`, `'serpentine'`, `'lanes'` |  | Layout flow: columns or serpentine for customer-journey, columns or lanes for architecture. |
| heightFill | string | `'rows'`, `'none'` | `'rows'` | Spare canvas height, read by hierarchy (org chart) and customer-journey. 'rows' (default): a canvas with a set height grows the gaps between the levels up to 2.6 times. 'none': natural gaps, the block centred. |

Plus the [shared options](options.md). This type does not accept `belowMinimum`, `unit`, `unitShown`, `strings`, `format`, `detailFields`, `smallValues`, `labelDensity`, `labels`, `categoryLabels`, `labelPlacements`, `legend`, `valueAxis`, `categoryAxis`, `secondaryAxis`, `scaleGroup`, `rowLabels`, `sort`, `topN`, `bandFraction`, `highlight`, `story`, `focus`, `hatchStrength`, `colorblindSafe`, `rounding`, `annotations`.

## Annotations

This type takes no annotations.

## Sizing

Floor 280 × 160 px; fit `content`.

Below the floor a render is refused with `size-below-floor` and the pixels it needs. `measure` returns the natural and comfortable size for a given spec; see [Sizing in the manual](../manual.md#sizing).
